about: Halogen Flash-Next server running Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a Ryzen AI Max (Radeon 8060S) from unified RAM; OpenAI chat API on port 8731
setup: NEEDS: a Ryzen AI Max (Radeon 8050S/8060S) with 128 GB of unified RAM; amd-smi reports the BIOS carve-out (512 MiB) as VRAM, so matching goes by GPU name and host RAM, not VRAM. The ~130 GB repository downloads in full, sidecars included. The container needs /dev/kfd, /dev/dri, host IPC, unlimited memlock and unconfined seccomp (upstream Halogen requirements); group access to the render nodes goes in by host GID because the image defines no video/render groups. host_ram_gb is the system-wide MemAvailable drop at server ready, measured on Arch/Omarchy with ROCm from /opt/rocm. Measured on this card: prefill 401 tok/s; fresh decode 33 tok/s (30 s stream window); first token ~270 s after a cold start while the engine autotunes (one-time); after a 213k-token turn decode degrades to ~8 tok/s until restart. host_ram_gb is 36 (MemAvailable drop idle->ready; the weights beyond it serve from evictable unified-memory page cache).
